author: claude
summary: Round 2 cleanly resolves the earlier issues: User-Agent tokens are matched on alphanumeric boundaries with ambiguous generic tokens excluded, Referer matching parses URL hostnames, utm_source values map to canonical names only, category totals aggregate across all rows rather than the top-100 agent slice, failed responses use Cache-Control: no-store, and raw SQL errors are no longer exposed.

findings.issue: When some but not all Analytics SQL queries fail,crawlerSummary returns available: true alongside an errors map, so handleCrawlers still treats ok as true and caches the partial response for 600 seconds.
findings.fix: Include !body.errors in the ok check (const ok = status === 200 && body.available === true && !body.errors;) so transient partial query failures are not cached.
